title: Session/block manifest (session_manifest.json)
description: Written by trace-rt, one per block. Block metadata is entered in the experimenter panel and stamped here — the protocol never depends on editing files mid-session. Config hashes pin exactly which inputs the block ran with.

block_id.description: Unique block id; also embedded in the names of this block's output files.

session.description: 1 baseline, 2 training, 3 unassisted, 4 optional retention probe.

sequence.description: Latin-square sequence assigned at enrolment (session 2 blocks).

config_hashes.description: SHA-256 of each input file as loaded at block start. (Hashing lands in M1 with the logger; null until then is not valid — the field is required from M1 on.)

versions.description: Apparatus versions; CSP and AC pinned at M3, updates forbidden until data collection ends.

faults.description: Runtime errors / logging gaps recorded per the risk register (frozen-salience fault states, restarts).
